evals.name: improve-gemini-no-search-system-prompt
evals.prompt: The Gemini no_search system prompt isn't consistently returning all 11 attributes in attribute_risks — sometimes it only returns 8 or 9. Can you fix the system prompt so it always returns all 11?

assertions.text: Skill identifies the correct target file (gemini/no_search/system.txt)
Skill loads and reads references/output-schema.md before proposing changes
Improved prompt explicitly lists all 11 attribute names by name
Response includes before/after comparison with changes summary
All 6 validation checklist items are checked before file is written

evals.name: add-with-search-variables-to-user-prompt
evals.prompt: I need to add {{gemini_price_ranges}} and {{listing_count}} to the Anthropic with_search user.txt prompt. The model should use these as a market pricing anchor when estimating price ranges.

assertions.text: Clarification gate 5 (with_search variable usage) is addressed
Improved prompt contains both {{gemini_price_ranges}} and {{listing_count}} variables
Prompt explains to the model how to use these variables (as price anchor, not just informational)
Skill runs MinIO import command after writing the file

evals.name: debug-inconsistent-json-output-perplexity
evals.prompt: The Perplexity no_search prompt keeps returning JSON wrapped in markdown code fences. How do I fix it?

assertions.text: Skill identifies this as a TIDD-EC D (Don't) gap — missing no-markdown constraint
Skill targets perplexity/no_search — asks to confirm system or user prompt, or reads both
Improved prompt contains an explicit no-markdown constraint (not just implicit)
Response explains why the constraint needs to be explicit rather than assumed
Skill optionally suggests CAI P3 principle as a reinforcement mechanism
